guitar.evidence: Beck uses a wide variety of guitars across his eclectic catalog (Silvertones, Jazzmasters, Danelectros, acoustics) with no single iconic model.
guitar.notes: Kept as low confidence given his genre-hopping, gear-varied output; refined model list slightly.

blocks.purpose: Clean up background noise and hum.

blocks.gap: The UK SLP is chosen for its classic, non-metal voicing suitable for lo-fi rock.

blocks.purpose: Provide a classic British cabinet sound to ground the tone.
Slightly scoop the low end and boost mids for a punchy, gritty rhythm sound.
Add subtle movement and vintage character to the rhythm parts.
blocks.gap: Tremolo was chosen over Chorus/Flanger to maintain the lo-fi, gritty feel while adding texture.

blocks.purpose: Provide the required short, springy reverb for a vintage feel.
